namespace = kCAFG_steward_task_promote

###############
# Side effects from Promote Culture
#3000-3299
###############

###Bad Side Effects


#Resistance to Settlers
# by Petter Vilberg
kCAFG_steward_task_promote.3001 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = {
			stewardship < high_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
			NOT = { has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_settler_resistance_modifier }
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = stewardship
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_steward = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_steward_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = steward_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}

		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_steward_task_bad
			title = steward_task.3001.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_bad_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_bad_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			
			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor
			tooltip = task_promote_culture_notification_tooltip

			scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_steward_settler_resistance_modifier
					days = steward_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


#Resistance to Administration
# by Petter Vilberg
kCAFG_steward_task_promote.3002 = {
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = {
			stewardship < high_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
			NOR = {
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_population_mismanaged_modifier
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_administration_embraced_modifier
			}
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = stewardship
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_steward = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_steward_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = steward_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}

		send_interface_message = {
			type = event_stewardship_bad
			title = steward_task.3002.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_bad_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_bad_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			
			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor
			tooltip = task_promote_culture_notification_tooltip

			scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_steward_population_mismanaged_modifier
					days = steward_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


###Good Side Effects



#Improve County Opinion
# by Petter Vilberg

kCAFG_steward_task_promote.3101 = {
	hidden = yes
	
	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = {
			stewardship > mediocre_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
			NOR = {
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_population_mismanaged_modifier
				has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_administration_embraced_modifier
			}
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = stewardship
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_steward = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_steward_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = steward_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}

		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_steward_task_good
			title = steward_task.3101.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_good_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_good_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			
			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor
			tooltip = task_promote_culture_notification_tooltip
			
			scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_steward_administration_embraced_modifier
					days = steward_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


#Successful Administration
# by Petter Vilberg

kCAFG_steward_task_promote.3102 = {
	hidden = yes
	
	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = {
			stewardship > mediocre_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
			NOT = { has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_welcome_administration_modifier }
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = stewardship
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_steward = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_steward_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = steward_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}

		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_steward_task_good
			title = steward_task.3102.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_good_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_good_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			
			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor
			tooltip = task_promote_culture_notification_tooltip
		
			scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_steward_welcome_administration_modifier
					days = steward_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


#Increased County Levies
# by Petter Vilberg

kCAFG_steward_task_promote.3103 = {
	hidden = yes
	
	trigger = {
		exists = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = cp:councillor_steward
		scope:councillor = {
			stewardship > mediocre_skill_rating
		}
        scope:councillor = { has_variable = kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province }
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
			NOT = { has_province_modifier = kCAFG_steward_realm_identity_modifier }
		}
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		compare_modifier = {
			target = scope:councillor
			value = stewardship
			multiplier = -0.2
			offset = inverted_high_skill_rating
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		cp:councillor_steward = {
			save_scope_as = active_councillor
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = had_steward_task_side_effect
			value = yes
			days = steward_task_side_effect_cooldown
		}

		send_interface_message = {
			type = msg_steward_task_good
			title = steward_task.3103.notification
			desc = {
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship <= average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_good_unskilled_notification_tooltip
				}
				triggered_desc = {
					trigger = {
						scope:active_councillor = { stewardship > average_skill_level }
					}
					desc = task_stewardship_good_skilled_notification_tooltip
				}
			}
			
			left_icon = scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province.barony
			right_icon = scope:councillor
			tooltip = task_promote_culture_notification_tooltip

			scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = {
				add_province_modifier = {
					modifier = kCAFG_steward_realm_identity_modifier
					days = steward_task_modifier_duration
				}
			}
		}
	}
}


#Steward deems conversion unnecessary
kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001 = {
	type = letter_event
	opening = {
		desc = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.opening
	}
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:focused_province = { T_kCAFG_province_only_culture = { CULTURE = scope:councillor_liege.culture } } }
				desc = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.desc_complete
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:focused_province = { var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension <= V_kCAFG_AI_suggestion_task_promotion_tension_threshold } }
				desc = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.desc_tension
			}
			desc = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.desc
		}
	}
	sender = scope:councillor

	immediate = {
		scope:councillor.var:kCAFG_task_promote_culture_focused_province = { save_scope_as = focused_province }
		
		scope:focused_province = { 
			# Parameters
			save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_set_default_focus_excluded_province
			save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_set_default_focus_can_redirect
			save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_set_default_focus_ai_select_for_liege
			#
			county = { E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_select_default_focus = yes }
		}
	}

	# I'll let you decide
	option = {
		name = {
			text = {
				first_valid = {
					triggered_desc = {
						trigger = { scope:focused_province = { T_kCAFG_province_only_culture = { CULTURE = scope:councillor_liege.culture } } }
						desc = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.a_complete
					}
					desc = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.a
				}
			}
		}
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:focused_province
					exists = scope:kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
					scope:councillor = { has_council_position = councillor_steward }
				}
				always = yes
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.a.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:councillor = {
				E_kCAFG_task_promote_culture_set_focus = { PROVINCE = scope:kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus }
				clear_saved_scope = kCAFG_selected_province_to_focus
			}
		}
		ai_chance = 1
	}

	# Keep it up
	option = {
		trigger = {
			scope:councillor = { is_performing_council_task = task_promote_culture }
			scope:focused_province = { NOT = { T_kCAFG_province_only_culture = { CULTURE = scope:councillor_liege.culture } } }
		}
		name = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.b
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.b.tt
		hidden_effect = { scope:councillor = { set_variable = kCAFG_steward_promotion_finish_focus } }
		ai_chance = 1
	}

	#Set to default task
	option = {
		name = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.c
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.c.tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:councillor = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_council_position = councillor_steward }
					start_default_task = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = 1
	}

	# Don't bother me
	option = {
		name = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.d
		custom_tooltip = kCAFG_steward_task_promote.9001.d.tt
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = kCAFG_ignore_steward_promotion_suggestions }
		ai_chance = 1
	}
}
